title: Market Signal Ethnography for Enterprise Inference Decision Flows
creator: Sofia Patel
description: Run a focused ethnographic-style research sprint to map how enterprise buyers make inference provider decisions. Objective: produce evidence-backed decision-flow diagrams, a lightweight Ops Readiness Index (ORI) for vendors, and a prioritized signal list to feed the continuous model-scout pipeline. This is qualitative-first: 12 interviews across three buyer cohorts (platform teams, product/ML leads, procurement/legal), several vendor-side conversations, and analysis of procurement artifacts (RFPs, vendor questionnaires). Deliverables will inform go-to-market messaging, product feature prioritization (SLA/observability/quantization compatibility), and criteria for automated model-scout alerts.
acceptance_criteria: 12 vetted interview transcripts with timestamped highlights and anonymized quotes
Three cohort-specific decision-flow diagrams (Platform, ML/Product, Procurement) validated in at least two follow-up stakeholder calls
Ops Readiness Index (ORI) scoring rubric with at least five weighted dimensions and sample scoring for 6 vendors/models
Top 10 procurement signals mapped to actionable product/ops telemetry and model-scout rules
Executive one-pager and a 12-slide presentation for GTM and Solutions teams
tasks: Recruit interview participants (target: 4 platform, 4 ML/Product, 4 procurement/legal)
Draft semi-structured interview guide (focus: triggers, switching costs, gating features, procurement timelines)
Schedule and conduct interviews (30–60 minute each), record and transcribe
Synthesize interviews into decision flows and identify common heuristics and friction points
Design ORI rubric and apply to 6 vendor/model examples (hosted vs dedicated vs private)
Produce prioritized signal list and map each to a telemetry/event source in console/usage logs
Create GTM brief and present findings to PM, Solutions, Sales Enablement
success_metrics: Research outputs accepted by PM and Solutions at review (>=90% acceptance)
At least 3 product/roadmap changes traceable to signals in the prioritized list within next quarter
Sales/SE report increased confidence in procurement conversations (self-reported) after brief
Model-scout pipeline adds 2 new automated signals derived from this work
